title: Normalized Project State v2 (Project Truth Control Plane)
description: Validation contract for normalized project-state v2 instances. Separates project_identity, current_execution, freshness, and progress so that Project Mission is never rewritten when a Work Order changes. State instances are YAML (automation/state/<project_id>.yaml). JSON Schema is used only as the validation contract because YAML is compatible with the JSON data model. Do not switch normalized project-state files from YAML to JSON. Created by WO-OBSIDIAN-036.

project_id.description: Stable identifier matching the Project Registry project_id.

github_repository_id.description: Stable GitHub repository numeric id. Survives repository rename. null for local-only projects.

source_path.description: Absolute local path of the source repository, or null for GitHub-only projects.

repository.description: Remote URL or null if no remote.

branch.description: Tracked branch or null if unknown.

head.description: HEAD commit SHA the truth was built from, or null if unknown.

knowledge_state.description: Whether the project's knowledge has been verified against source evidence.

project_identity.description: Stable Project Mission. Only `purpose` is derived from explicit Purpose/Mission/Problem text in authoritative repository documents; the remaining identity fields are schema-supported-but-not-derived (null until an evidence-backed extractor exists). MUST NOT be rewritten when a Work Order changes. A bare project title/heading/repository name is NOT sufficient to verify the Mission.

purpose.description: What the project is, in one line. Derived ONLY from explicit Purpose/Mission/Problem/Designed-to text. null/unknown if evidence insufficient (a bare heading or project name is NOT sufficient).

problem_statement.description: The problem the project exists to solve. Schema-supported-but-not-derived (null until an evidence-backed extractor exists).

primary_users.description: Who the project is for. Schema-supported-but-not-derived.

identity_drift_detected.description: True when authoritative evidence indicates the Mission itself has changed. The previous identity is preserved; the candidate new identity + its evidence provenance are recorded in candidate_identity/candidate_identity_provenance. The existing purpose is NOT silently overwritten.

previous_identity.description: Preserved previous identity snapshots when drift is detected. null when no drift.

candidate_identity.description: The candidate new identity proposed by evidence when drift is detected. null when no drift. Inspectable but NOT applied automatically.

candidate_identity_provenance.description: Evidence provenance for the candidate identity (path, ref, blob_sha, observed_at). null when no drift.

current_execution.description: Current execution truth. Distinct from Project Mission. May change per Work Order without affecting project_identity.

lifecycle_phase.description: Current lifecycle phase (e.g. active, paused, stable, research-prototype). null if unknown.

current_goal.description: Current goal or null if none/unknown.

current_work.description: Current work description or null if none/unknown.

path.description: Source file/path the current-work claim was read from, or null.

kind.description: Type of authority document, or null.

current_work_evidence.description: How strongly the current-work claim is supported.

last_completed.description: Last completed milestone/work or null if unknown.

blockers.description: Current blockers or null if none.

next_action.description: Next authoritative action or null if unknown. Derived from explicit authority only; never invented.

freshness.description: Freshness contract. remote_head != truth_built_from_head => stale. GitHub unreachable => unknown. UNKNOWN must never become FRESH. refresh_failed preserves known-good truth with a stale marker.

tracked_ref.description: The tracked ref (e.g. 'main') the truth is bound to.

remote_head.description: Latest remote HEAD SHA observed at source_checked_at, or null if unreachable.

truth_built_from_head.description: HEAD SHA the semantic truth was built from. Equal to remote_head => fresh.

source_checked_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the remote HEAD was last probed.

truth_built_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the semantic truth was last built.

stale_since.description: ISO-8601 timestamp since when the truth has been stale, or null.

reason.description: Human-readable reason for stale/unknown/refresh_failed, or null.

source_freshness.description: Whether the source HEAD is fresh relative to truth_built_from_head.

semantic_freshness.description: Whether the semantic truth (identity/execution) is fresh relative to the source.

progress_freshness.description: Whether the progress computation is fresh relative to the source.

progress.description: Deterministic, evidence-constrained progress. Never an LLM impression. Supports unknown when denominator is missing.

scope.description: What the progress estimate measures (e.g. 'current_goal', 'current_roadmap'). null if unknown.

estimate.description: Point estimate 0-100, or null if unknown.

range_min.description: Lower bound, or null if unknown.

range_max.description: Upper bound, or null if unknown.

completed.description: Count of completed units, or null if unknown.

active.description: Count of active/in-progress units, or null if unknown.

remaining.description: Count of remaining units, or null if unknown.

basis.description: Evidence basis explaining how the numbers were derived, or null.

github.description: GitHub live truth (read-only adapter output). Tied to the exact head SHA.

open_pr.description: First open PR number or null.

open_pr_count.description: Count of open PRs or null.

observed_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when GitHub truth was last observed.

last_change.description: ISO-8601 date of last commit on the tracked ref, or null if unknown.

evidence_classification.description: Overall evidence confidence for the normalized state record as a whole.

verified_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when this state was verified, or null.

adapter_id.description: Identifier of the adapter that produced this state.
